description: This file contains unit tests for Orleans' handling of external types, specifically testing serialization of enum types defined outside of grain interfaces and implementations. It verifies that Orleans can correctly process external enum types passed as parameters to grain methods.

classes.name: ExternalTypesTests
classes.description: Unit test class for verifying Orleans' handling of external types, especially enums, in grain method parameters.

methods.name: ExternalTypesTest_GrainWithEnumExternalTypeParam
methods.description: Test method that verifies grains can receive and process external enum types.
